correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from definitions. Membership in the generated vector lattice yields a finite closed cover by algebraic-tensor branches; Baire gives one open rectangle of finite separation rank. A basis of local sections and an invertible evaluation matrix produce analytic coefficient functions. The resulting analytic residual vanishes on an open rectangle, so the real-analytic identity theorem propagates the separated representation across the connected interior, and continuity extends it to the boundary. The zero-rank case is handled separately. No computation, sampling, or approximation is used as an infinite proof.
